# Pallet Designer

> Pallet Designer is a tool for industrial automation integrators
> and manufacturing plants for configuring palletizing layouts without
> programming the PLC, HMI or robot. From a layer pattern it calculates
> the complete robot pick-and-place sequence automatically, and it exports
> the whole configuration to the machine. It cuts the time to start up a
> new layout from days to minutes.

## Key facts
- Product: Pallet Designer
- Industry: industrial automation, palletizing, depalletizing
- Target users: automation system integrators, manufacturing plants, PLC/HMI programmers, robot programmers, sales teams for palletizing machines
- Sales model: licences for the integrator and for the end customer, plus optional machine integration; pricing on request
- Vendor: Pallet Designer (Mardan Automatyka; legal name: Marcin Daniun Automatyka, Poland)

## Features
- Automatic robot move planning: from a layer pattern the program calculates the complete robot sequence - which cases the gripper picks together (multi-case gripping), collision-free gripper positions, approach direction and placing order; manual mode for special cases; batch computing of many layers
- Automatic layer pattern optimization: auto fill proposes layouts with the maximum number of cases, marks proven optimal layouts, and builds interlocked alternating layers (layer A/B)
- Visual layer pattern and pallet stack designer: labels-outward orientation, overhang control, slip sheets, 3D pallet view
- Mixed-product palletizing on a single pallet (variant mix)
- Production orders for palletizing and depalletizing
- Validation against the real station: gripper, reach, allowed rotations, station obstacles and PLC array limits are checked before data reaches the machine
- Generation of data ready to load into the machine (Siemens TIA Portal data block, JSON, CSV, custom structures)
- Ready function blocks, HMI screens and scripts for Siemens PLC/HMI as part of the delivery; other control platforms on request
- Configuration export for robot simulation environments (e.g. FANUC ROBOGUIDE)
- Automatic PDF documentation of the layout
- Self-service mode: end-customer configurator (an operator or process engineer designs layouts themselves, within parameters set up by the integrator)
- Multi-workstation use with a shared data folder and edit locks
- Multilingual interface, user manual and PDF documentation; further languages on request

## Pricing model
- Pricing is on request for every component: contact the vendor for a quote.
- Integrator licence: full program functionality, data export to the machine, files for robot simulation, PDF documentation, user manual and team training; works without permanent internet; transferable between devices.
- End-customer application licence: the configurator delivered together with the machine, so the end customer creates new layouts within parameters set up by the integrator.
- Machine integration: ready PLC function blocks, HMI screens and scripts (Siemens standard), team training and assistance at first commissioning; other control systems and custom modifications on request.
- Before buying: 20-minute online demo on the customer's own pallet layout, followed by a tailored offer. A demo version for the customer's own tests is available on request.
